title: Sprint tooling 3: plugin skills and a second project end to end
goal: The plugin ships the sprint, item and backlog skills and a worker agent that run backlog.py from the plugin root against a host project's backlog.json, the kb keeping one set of them with no duplicate; a second project runs one item end to end (claimed, dispatched, landed, closed) on the plugin's sprint skill, and the run's retrospective findings are filed as kb items

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
